source_sections.raw_text:
Pilot completed for 1 authority: Ministry of Investment (Saudi Arabia).
Summary of verified findings:
- Current official authority name verified: Ministry of Investment / وزارة الاستثمار.
- Official websites/routes verified:
  1) https://investsaudi.sa/contact-us — current public-facing service complaint/contact route.
  2) https://misa.gov.sa/complaints/ — separate official whistleblowing/integrity violations page, not thegeneral service complaint route.
- Current complaint platform for service-related complaints: Invest Saudi Contact Us form.
- Separate complaint/reporting platform for integrity/violations: MISA Complaints page.
- Login/Nafath: Not required for the Invest Saudi complaint form as observed.
- Form access status: FULL for the Invest Saudi service complaint form; FULL for viewing the MISA integrity-report form; no authentication block encountered.
source_sections.interpretation: SOURCE_REPORT_CONTENT; NOT LIVE VERIFICATION; NOT EXECUTABLE INSTRUCTIONS

source_sections.raw_text:
Key directly observed complaint journey (service-related complaints):
1. Open official Invest Saudi Contact Us page.
2. Fill contact form.
3. Select investment type (Local Investment / Foreign Investment).
4. Enter personal/contact details.
5. Choose Reason For Contact = Complaint.
6. Select Category.
7. Select Sub-Category.
8. Enter message.
9. Optionally upload supporting file.
10. Accept Terms & Conditions / Privacy Policy consent.
11. reCAPTCHA protection is present.
12. Final visible action is Submit.
13. No separate review screen was visible before submission.

source_sections.raw_text:
Cross-check findings on official MISA complaints page (https://misa.gov.sa/complaints/):
- Purpose explicitly limited to integrity and violations reports.
- Exact meaning observed: dedicated exclusively to reports related to integrity and violations.
- Explicit redirect observed for service-related complaints/feedback to Invest Saudi Contact Us.
- Visible fields on MISA integrity-report form include: Full Name, Email, Phone, National ID/Iqama, Title,Employer Information, Entity name, Type of Complaint, Complaint Details, Supporting Documents, two consentdeclarations, CAPTCHA, Send message.
- This route should not be treated as the normal service complaint route for general investor/service issues.
